interfaces.label: Backplane connector
interfaces.desc: Plugs into a backplane slot. Carries CAN.

interfaces.label: Gondola power input
interfaces.desc: 28 V supply from the BEXUS gondola, up to 2.8 A. Goes through an ideal diode and an EMI filter.

interfaces.label: 24 V to backplane A
interfaces.desc: 24 V rail from the two on-board DC/DC converters, three 24 V and three GND pins. Wired in parallel with the other 24 V connector.

interfaces.label: 24 V to backplane B
interfaces.desc: 24 V rail from the two on-board DC/DC converters, three 24 V and three GND pins. Wired in parallel with the other 24 V connector.

interfaces.label: Vacuum pump power
interfaces.desc: Switched 24 V supply for the vacuum pump.

interfaces.label: Vacuum pump control
interfaces.desc: UART and on/off signal to the vacuum pump.

interfaces.label: Solenoid
interfaces.desc: Low-side driven solenoid on switched 24 V.

interfaces.label: Optical particle counter
interfaces.desc: Switched 5 V supply and SPI for the optical particle counter.

interfaces.label: Filter wheel position
interfaces.desc: Three position indicator signals from the filter wheel.
